title: Substitute (x+h) for x
text:
Replace every $x$ in the function with $(x+h)$:

$f(x+h) = (x+h)^2 - 4(x+h) + 3$

title: Expand the Perfect Square
text:
Use the identity $(a+b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2$:

$(x+h)^2 = x^2 + 2xh + h^2$

Also expand $-4(x+h) = -4x - 4h$

title: Complete the Expansion
text:
Combining all terms:

$f(x+h) = x^2 + 2xh + h^2 - 4x - 4h + 3$

This is the expanded form needed for the next step.
